description.value: A double-blind, placebo-controlled study examined whether a single intramuscular injection of extended-release naltrexone attenuates BOLD fMRI responses to alcohol-related visual and olfactory cues in detoxified alcohol-dependent volunteers.

spans.text: The present study was a double-blind, placebo-controlled between-subject design to test whether XR-NTX attenuates brain responses to alcohol-related olfactory and visual cues in treatment-seeking alcohol-dependent individuals.

description.value: The study used a double-blind, placebo-controlled between-subject design with fMRI assessments immediately before and two weeks after injection.

description.value: BOLD fMRI data were processed using FSL Release 4.1.2 and FEAT 5.98. Processing included despiking, motion correction, slice-timing correction, brain extraction, spatial filtering, global normalization, temporal high-pass filtering, and temporal Tukey prewhitening; excessive-motion images were modeled with single-image regressors.
